data.Name: Definitely Real Map
data.Description: A shifty-eyed merchant unfurls a piece of parchment covered in crayon drawings, coffee stains, and what appears to be a child's drawing of a dragon. 'Genuine treasure map!' they whisper. 'Only slightly used!'
